steps: Open the app in a fresh browser context, enter the name 'Rev P sam6', Start
Take a 1.3 quiz to the end (progress shows 13 answered, 9 mistakes)
Open a second, fresh browser context (new device/browser), enter exactly the same name, Start
Open Progress and Review mistakes
expected: The learner chooser says 'Progress and mistakes are saved on the server under your name. No password.' so the same name should bring back the quiz history and mistakes
actual: Progress shows 'No quizzes yet.' and the review page 'Nothing to review'. The network log for the whole session contains only GET / and GET /app.js: nothing is ever sent to a server; the profile lives only in this browser's localStorage (keys stats-profile, stats-profile:<id>). The same name even resolves to the same profile id (rev-p-sam6-406d73), but the data is not there. Clearing site data or using another browser loses everything, contrary to the on-screen promise.

steps: Choose a learner, open section 1.3, start a 10-question quiz
Answer questions 1-3 (they are graded and logged), click Next so 'Question 4 of 10' is showing
Press the browser reload button
Finish the quiz, then open Progress
expected: The quiz resumes at question 4 (or at least the learner is told the attempt was abandoned); answers already given are not counted twice
actual: After reload the same URL (same seed) shows 'Question 1 of 10' with the same questions and empty answer controls. The three answers already given were already recorded, so after re-answering all 10 the Progress table shows 13 answered for a 10-question quiz, with the first three questions and their mistakes logged twice. The same happens in a review session: reloading during 'Question 1 of 4' drops back to the review list and the session is gone.

steps: Finish a section 1.3 quiz so the results page ('Section 1.3: 2 / 10 correct (20%)') is showing
Press reload
expected: The results page (or the chapter page) comes back
actual: The page shows 'Question 1 of 10' of the same quiz again with the same questions. A learner who reloads the results page thinks the quiz was not saved and retakes it; every answer is then counted as a second attempt in Progress.

steps: Choose a learner, take a 10-question 1.3 quiz (worked problems: some) and miss 8 questions of mixed kinds: 'compute the mean' (numeric), two relative-frequency table questions (numeric), three level-of-measurement/table multiple choice, and two worked problems (rainfall table, gum-disease flossing) self-marked 'I missed it'
Open Review mistakes: it lists a single entry '§1.3 ○○ missed 8×'
Start review; answer question 1 wrong, then questions 2 and 3 right (one relative-frequency numeric, one level-of-measurement MC)
Open Progress
expected: Each missed concept is re-tested until it is answered correctly twice in a row, as the page says ('Every concept you missed stays open until you answer it correctly twice in a row')
actual: All eight quiz mistakes plus the review mistake flip to 'understood' at once after two correct answers on any two 1.3 questions. The mean computation, the rainfall and flossing worked problems and the other misses were never asked again; the review session only had 4 questions for 9 open mistakes. The 'concept' is the whole section, so the streak indicator (○○ / ●○) is per section, not per mistake, and a learner cannot trust 'understood' in the mistake log. Conversely, a single wrong Retry on one understood item reopens all ten entries as 'still open'.

steps: With '§1.3 missed 8×' open, Start review
Answer question 1 wrong, then 2 and 3 right (concept becomes understood), answer 4 and click Finish
expected: A single consistent end state: either the concept is still open and listed, or the page says there is nothing left to review
actual: The page shows the green box 'Nothing to review. Take a quiz to find gaps.' directly above a summary 'Mistake review: 3 / 4 correct (75%) — Concepts to review: §1.3 — 1 missed' and a primary 'Review mistakes' button that just reloads the same empty list. Also, from question 3 onward the concept list above the question card silently disappears while the session continues.

steps: Take a 1.3 quiz and miss the worked problems 'Sixty adults with gum disease...' and 'the table below shows the amount, in inches, of annual rainfall...' and the multi-part 'What type of measure scale is being used?'
Open Progress and read the Mistake log
expected: The question and the correct answer are shown as readable text/tables, as they are in the quiz
actual: Entries show the raw markup: '[TABLE]...', '[PARTS] ... [/PARTS]', and the correct answer as '[PARTS] a. [TABLE] # Flossing per Week | Frequency | Relative Frequency | ... 0 | 27 | 0.4500 | 0.4500 1 | 18 ...' run together on one line. Other entries show whole table rows as 'x | y | z' text with '[/TABLE]'.

steps: Take a 1.3 quiz and get a generated table question wrong (e.g. 'Find the relative frequency for 1 days. Round to four decimals.' with a Days/Frequency table)
Open Progress, Mistake log
expected: Enough of the question to make sense of the correct answer
actual: The entry shows only 'Find the relative frequency for 1 days. Round to four decimals. your answer: 999 · correct: 0.3462' — the scenario table the number came from is not shown, so the logged correct answer cannot be checked or learned from. Same for the 'cumulative relative frequency for N days' entries and the multiple-choice 'The cumulative relative frequency for 10 distance learning credit units is: correct: d. 0.76'.

steps: Choose a learner, open Progress (or Review mistakes)
Click 'switch' in the header
expected: The learner chooser (name box + recent learners) appears
actual: The header changes to 'Choose learner' and the page body becomes 'Choose a learner first.' with a 'Choose a learner' link; only after that extra click does the chooser on the home page appear. From the home page the same button shows the chooser directly.

steps: On the learner chooser type a name longer than 40 characters, e.g. 'Bartholomew Montgomery-Fitzgerald the Third of Wessex', click Start
expected: Either the full name is accepted or the learner is told about the limit
actual: The name is cut mid-word to 40 characters ('Bartholomew Montgomery-Fitzgerald the Th') with no message, and that truncated name is what the header, the 'Learning as' card and the Progress heading show from then on.

steps: Start a section 1.1 quiz with worked problems 'only'
Show model answer, click 'I missed it'
expected: The feedback box shows 'Not quite.' and the model solution
actual: The red box shows 'Not quite.' then an empty 'Correct answer:' label with nothing after it, then 'Model solution:' with the text. The empty label is left over from the checked question layout.
